Klasse ClientApi

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.client.clientLogic.ClientApi
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
IClientApi
public class ClientApi extends Object implements IClientApi
Client API for interacting with the game server. Provides methods for connecting, pinging, requesting lobbies, creating lobbies, and joining lobbies.
